{{Top|leg}}
'''Powdered milk''' was a type of [[Milk/Legends|milk]] that was made by mixing the powdered form with [[Water/Legends|water]] to reconstitute it.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], powdered milk was among the food supplies that [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]] used as cover story when [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] inspected her [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Cornucopia]]''. Unbeknownst to the stormtroopers, Vollen was hiding two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;[[Kina Ha]] and [[Tallisibeth Enwandung-Esterhazy]]&mdash;aboard her vessel.<ref name="Imperial Commando: 501st" />
